traits.name: Fae Contract
traits.description: Bound by a pact with the fae; must negotiate or fulfill terms
traits.expression: You are bound by fae magic; they whisper in your mind.
traits.story_hook: Every generation must renegotiate or enforce the pact.

traits.name: Blood Debt
traits.description: You owe blood to an entity; can be paid or inherited
traits.expression: Your blood is not your own; it belongs to another.
traits.story_hook: Pay your blood debt or it grows with each generation.

traits.name: Lich's Binding
traits.description: Bound to a lich; serves their will or breaks the binding
traits.expression: A lich's shadow falls across your life.
traits.story_hook: Free yourself or become a thrall.

traits.name: Werewolf Curse
traits.description: Transform on the full moon; must control the beast or be consumed
traits.expression: Beast instincts war with your human mind.
traits.story_hook: Master the beast or it will master you.

traits.name: Prophecy Binding
traits.description: Bound to a prophecy; it will come true whether you resist or embrace it
traits.story_hook: Fulfill the prophecy, break it, or defy it.
